narr: An unsettled weather pattern set up across South FL as a plume of tropical moisture settled across the region. The excess moisture along with the presence of a surface boundary along the coast promoted heavy rainfall and flooding across portions of Broward County.
ev: The public shared via social media videos of flash flooding in downtown Fort Lauderdale showing water above curbs, over sidewalks, and entering ground floor store fronts.
